The**Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Υποδομών και Μεταφορών) is a[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))of[Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece)headquartered in[Cholargos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cholargos),[Athens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Athens).[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Infrastructure_and_Transport_(Greece)#cite_note-4)

The ministry is currently headed by Christos Dimas.
